The dish is a square white plate, about 26 cm across. The food is a small pile of arugula with a few golden raisins and possibly some nuts, covered in a light dressing. The pile takes up roughly 12 × 10 cm.

Arugula is very light, so a loose pile of this size is probably about 30–40 g. The raisins and dressing add maybe 10 g and 10 ml of oil, so the total is about 50 g.

For energy, arugula is about 25 kcal per 100 g, so roughly 10 kcal. A few raisins add about 15 kcal, and about 1 teaspoon of oil in the dressing adds about 40 kcal. The total comes to about 65 kcal. I'll round up slightly to allow for extra dressing.
